findings.quote: the affair of the people of Palairos
findings.problem: Greek has τὸν περὶ τοὺς Παλαιεῖς ἐμποδισμόν: the Paleis, people of Pale in Cephallenia (the same Paleis besieged by Philip, as ch. 17 has it), not Palairos in Acarnania (which would be Παλαιρεῖς).
findings.proposed_fix: the affair of the people of Pale

findings.quote: crossed the gulf, and came to anchor at Leucas as quickly as possible. There he instructed the officers
findings.problem: Greek has ὡς θᾶττον εἰς τὴν Λευκάδα καθωρμίσθη, τοῖς … συνέταξε: temporal 'as soon as he had anchored at Leucas, he instructed ...', not 'anchored as quickly as possible'.
findings.proposed_fix: crossed the gulf, and as soon as he had anchored at Leucas he instructed the officers

units.note: Greek breaks off mid-sentence at chapter end (ἀπουράγει τοῖς αὑτοῦ φαλαγγίταις); a seam, not a lacuna in the text.
